title: Synthetic LuFe/Mn/O title
text: Synthetic LuFe/Mn/O BT-7 PSD elastic diffraction temperature-map study.

title: Synthetic BT-7 PSD methods
text: Synthetic methods: powder samples of LuFe_{1-x}Mn_xO3 were measured on BT-7 using PSD elastic diffraction temperature scans. The experiment used fixed final energy and detector channels; PSD channel-to-Q conversion requires reviewed calibration.

title: Synthetic sample description
text: Synthetic sample description: LuFe_{1-x}Mn_xO3 powder compositions include x_Mn = 0.25, x_Mn = 0.4, and x_Mn = 0.5. The shorthand LuMnFeO3 remains ambiguous without panel labels or sample logs.

title: Synthetic LuFe/Mn/O Figure Caption
text: Figure 1 panels (i), (j), and (k) show elastic PSD temperature maps for LuFe_{1-x}Mn_xO3 powder samples with x_Mn = 0.25, x_Mn = 0.4, and x_Mn = 0.5, respectively. The plotted axes are Q from about 1.10 to 1.45 angstrom^-1 and temperature from about 0 to 200 K.

title: Synthetic PSD artifact review note
text: Synthetic review note: detector-channel hot pixels and unmasked efficiency outliers can create vertical stripes in PSD maps. Broad terms such as BT-7 and temperature are metadata filters, not sufficient evidence for source-data claims.
